title: Session Board Auto
intro: Auto on a job board that runs in your own signed-in session is a separate, riskier opt-in. It stays off until you read the warning below and type the board's name, and it always runs under stricter limits than any other Auto Rule.

limits: Stricter limits apply on top of the rule: at least 10 minutes between applications, an Outbox hold of at least 60 minutes, and the Kill Switch stops everything.

warning.tos: {name}'s terms may forbid automated applying. Doing it anyway can get your account restricted or banned, and the risk is yours.
warning.ban: A CAPTCHA, a sign-in wall, an "unusual activity" warning or a rate limit pauses Auto on this board for seven days.
warning.limits: Three applications a day by default (ten at most), at least 10 minutes apart, with an Outbox hold of at least 60 minutes. Boba never signs in, creates accounts or solves CAPTCHAs.
